messages.content: ترجم الوحدات الإنجليزية إلى عربية فصحى أمينة. أخرج كائن JSON فقط بهذا الشكل: {"book_code":"2ES","verses":[{"chapter":1,"verse":1,"text_ar":"النص المترجم","review_notes_ar":[]}]}. انسخ أرقام الفصل والآية كما هي، وعنصراً واحداً لكل وحدة.

{"verses":[{"text":"After seven days, the thoughts of my heart were very grievous to me again,","verse":21,"chapter":5},{"text":"and my soul recovered the spirit of understanding, and I began to speak words before the Most High again.","verse":22,"chapter":5},{"text":"I said, “O sovereign Lord of all the woods of the earth, and of all the trees thereof, you have chosen one vine for yourself.","verse":23,"chapter":5},{"text":"Of all the lands of the world you have chosen one country for yourself. Of all the flowers of the world, you have chosen one lily for yourself.","verse":24,"chapter":5},{"text":"Of all the depths of the sea, you have filled one river for yourself. Of all built cities, you have consecrated Zion for yourself.","verse":25,"chapter":5},{"text":"Of all the birds that are created you have named for yourself one dove. Of all the livestock that have been made, you have provided for yourself one sheep.","verse":26,"chapter":5},{"text":"Among all the multitudes of peoples you have gotten yourself one people. To this people, whom you loved, you gave a law that is approved by all.","verse":27,"chapter":5},{"text":"Now, O Lord, why have you given this one people over to many, and have dishonored the one root above others, and have scattered your only one among many?","verse":28,"chapter":5},{"text":"Those who opposed your promises have trampled down those who believed your covenants.","verse":29,"chapter":5},{"text":"If you really do hate your people so much, they should be punished with your own hands.”","verse":30,"chapter":5},{"text":"Now when I had spoken these words, the angel that came to me the night before was sent to me,","verse":31,"chapter":5},{"text":"and said to me, “Hear me, and I will instruct you. Listen to me, and I will tell you more.”","verse":32,"chapter":5},{"text":"I said, “Speak on, my Lord.” Then said he to me, “You are very troubled in mind for Israel’s sake. Do you love that people more than he who made them?”","verse":33,"chapter":5},{"text":"I said, “No, Lord; but I have spoken out of grief; for my heart is in agony every hour while I labor to comprehend the way of the Most High, and to seek out part of his judgment.”","verse":34,"chapter":5},{"text":"He said to me, “You can’t.” And I said, “Why, Lord? Why was I born? Why wasn’t my mother’s womb my grave, that I might not have seen the travail of Jacob, and the wearisome toil of the people of Israel?”","verse":35,"chapter":5},{"text":"He said to me, “Count for me those who haven’t yet come. Gather together for me the drops that are scattered abroad, and make the withered flowers green again for me.","verse":36,"chapter":5},{"text":"Open for me the chambers that are closed, and bring out the winds for me that are shut up in them. Or show me the image of a voice. Then I will declare to you the travail that you asked to see.”","verse":37,"chapter":5},{"text":"And I said, “O sovereign Lord, who may know these things except he who doesn’t have his dwelling with men?","verse":38,"chapter":5},{"text":"As for me, I lack wisdom. How can I then speak of these things you asked me about?”","verse":39,"chapter":5},{"text":"Then said he to me, “Just as you can do none of these things that I have spoken of, even so you can’t find out my judgment, or the end of the love that I have promised to my people.”","verse":40,"chapter":5}],"chapter":5,"book_code":"2ES"}
